terminals.name: backend
terminals.description: Express API + Socket.IO on port 5000. Creates and seeds the local SQLite database (data/erp.db) on first boot; default admin login is admin / admin123.

terminals.name: frontend
terminals.description: Vite dev server on port 3000. Proxies /api, /uploads and /socket.io to the backend on 127.0.0.1:5000. Open http://localhost:3000 to use the app.
